tests.title: Chemical Usage lists chemicals first expiry first
tests.goal:
First expiry, first use

Verify that Chemical Usage orders chemicals so the one that expires first is used first.
preconditions: At least two chemicals of the same kind with different expiry dates

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Inventory > Chemical Usage
Search for a chemical name that has several batches

expected.text: Use order 1, 2, 3 ... follows the expiry date from earliest to latest
Each row shows CAS, classification, batch, production, expiry and delivery dates, room and item number

notes: Two batches of "QA print chem 42609" in Chemistry: 003000032 (expiry 13/12/2026) "Use next", 003000025 (15/01/2027) second.

tests.title: A new item passes gantry 1a before check-in without an alert
tests.goal:
Gantry 1a before check-in

Verify that a pre checked-in item (status NOT CHECKED IN) passing gantry 1a is logged as NOT CHECKED IN, moves to Airlock 1 and raises no alert.
preconditions: An item with status NOT CHECKED IN (pre checked in and counted on the handheld)

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account and note the Dashboard alert count
Send a read of the item at gantry 1a (real gantry, or Swagger POST /api/Gantry/authorizerfid)
Open Gantry > Gantry Log and refresh the Dashboard after one minute

expected.text: Gantry Log lists the item with Gantry 1a EXIT, Status NOT CHECKED IN, Location Airlock 1
No alert is raised for the item

notes: 002000017 (NOT CHECKED IN after handheld pre check-in) read at gantry 1a via API: Gantry Log "1a EXIT / NOT CHECKED IN / Airlock 1 / Authorized", item moved to Airlock 1, no new alert.

tests.title: A loaned item that comes back goes through pre check-in, count and check-in again
tests.goal:
Loan return

Verify that a returned loan item is pre checked in and counted on the handheld and checked in again, without a new tag, and ends IN and off the whitelist.
preconditions: An item checked out on Loan

steps.text: On the handheld, pre check-in the returned item (scan its tag) and count it
Carry it through gantry 1a (or send the read through Swagger)
Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account and check the item in at its storage location

expected.text: After pre check-in the item's status is NOT CHECKED IN and it is listed under Tagged Not Checked In
After check-in the status is IN and the item can be checked out again
The item is no longer on the gantry whitelist
No tag reprint was needed (same chip code)

notes: 001000031 loaned (loan 27, whitelisted) -> handheld pre check-in shows "Loan" -> NOT CHECKED IN -> gantry 1a NOT CHECKED IN -> handheld check-in -> IN, purpose cleared, off the whitelist; Loan Out Report Returned 18/11/2026 16:09.

tests.title: Checking out a chemical out of FEFO order shows a warning
tests.goal:
FEFO: order

Verify that checking out a batch of a chemical while an earlier-expiring batch is still in stock shows a FEFO warning but allows the check-out.
preconditions: Two IN batches of the same chemical with different expiry dates

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Inventory > Chemical Usage and note which batch is Use order 1
Open Check Out, tick the later-expiring batch and check it out For use

expected.text: A warning says an earlier-expiring batch should be used first
After confirming, the item is checked out (status OUT)

notes: Check Out 003000025 For use while 003000032 expires earlier: confirmation "First expiry, first use - ... Instead of 003000025 ..., use 003000032 ..."; after OK checked out.

tests.title: A stock take goes from Draft to Completed with handheld scan results
tests.goal:
Stock take cycle

Verify that a stock take created on the web can be commenced, scanned on the handheld and completed, and that the results show which items were located.
preconditions: Two IN items that are not in another stock take for the chosen period
data: Proposed dates: today to today + 7 days

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Create a stock take with the two items and open it from Stock Take List > Show
Click Commence and confirm
On the handheld: Update all data, open Stocktake, select the stock take, scan only the first item and Upload anyway
On the web: open the stock take again and click Complete, confirm
Open Report > Stock Take Progress Report and Stock Take Report for the stock take number

expected.text: After Commence the status is In Progress with a commencement date
The handheld lists both items as Unlocated before the scan, and 1 Located / 1 Unlocated after it
After Complete the status is Completed; the first item is Located (scanned by the user, time), the second Not located
The progress report shows Completed, Total Item 2, Total Scanned 1
Completing does not change the status of the not-located item (still IN)

notes: ST00000015: Draft -> Commence (In Progress) -> handheld scan 1 of 2 -> Complete; Located 002000017, Not located 003000032 (still IN); progress report Completed 2/1.

tests.title: Stock-take adjustment disposes an item that was not located
tests.goal:
Stock adjustment

Verify that after a completed stock take an administrator can set a not-located item to DISPOSED, which takes it out of stock and tracking.
preconditions: A completed stock take with at least one Not located item

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Open the stock take from Stock Take List > Show
Under Stock-take adjustment tick the not-located item, choose New status DISPOSED, enter the reason and click Adjust 1 selected

expected.text: The message "1 tag(s) adjusted." is shown
Item Information shows the item with status DISPOSED
The item is no longer offered in Check Out or Chemical Usage
Audit Trail has "Stock adjustment ... Status: IN → DISPOSED" with the reason

notes: Stock-take adjustment 003000032 -> DISPOSED: "1 tag(s) adjusted."; DISPOSED in the API, gone from Check Out and Chemical Usage; Audit "Stock adjustment ... IN -> DISPOSED".
